relations.evidence: rājyaṃ śāsati bhūpatīndranṛpatau ... alikhat sat chatrasiṃhaḥ

date.as_written: śrīmadvāridhibrahmadiggajamitau nepālasamvatsare, māghe māsi śi(!)teʼrkkapañcamitithau sidhyuttare revatī ... samvat 817 māghaśuklapaṃcamyān tithau utra(!)bhadranakṣe(!)tre, siddhiyoge āditya vāla kunhu

notes: King Bhūpatīndra is the Malla king Bhūpatīndramalla of Bhaktapur (r. 1696–1722 CE). The chronogram vāridhi (7), brahma (1), diggaja (8) gives NS 817.
